purpose_context: On a fresh clone the status board refuses with a raw unreadable-ref error and the recovery text claims the branch was never fetched while omitting the step that actually unblocks reads. This Mission makes every remote-only refusal carry one canonical, truthful remedy naming the right remote.
purpose_tldr: Give operators on a fresh clone a complete, truthful recovery path when a Mission's coordination or topic branch exists only on a remote.
